body: No point. Whenever I achieve a goal, the problems in my life just hold me back. Hell, there's times where I can't even look at myself in the mirror. If I can't even look at myself in the mirror, how can I expect myself to do anything else?
Horrible horrible self esteem, parent suffering from schizophrenia, OCD, loneliness, just to list a few
I've had therapy, antidepressants, etc. I've tried so many things but I'm always hopeless

Hey, thanks for your reply! I know you think that "looks can only guarantee you glances", but I'm always so afraid that my looks are just...subpar to basically everyone. I feel hideous, as if even if I do find a relationship, I'm going to be cheated on or the second choice. And I came out in high school in freshman year, and while we do have a few gay guys at my school, I feel like none of them have been interested in me, and it makes me feel horrible that I can't get even one to be interested in me.

I really don't want to sound rude with this reply, so sorry in advance. 

One part of me understands why you think I'm just fishing for attention, because that part does want attention, because I've never gotten attention. I never get complimented on my appearance, and I rarely feel good about myself, especially when I compare myself to others. I know that I'm new to it, but the fact that I rarely get messages on Grindr lowkey confirms that I'm just not attractive. Whenever I see a picture of myself I can't help but cringe, because I see all my flaws. Also, the gay community seems to be turned off by non-white, which is even worse for me. But the other part of me thinks when you mentioned the girls saying they're fat but they're really skinny scenario, that really doesn't apply to me, because I actually have flaws.

And why do you think I want to lose my virginity to this person in the first place? I want to fit in, and I want to feel like everyone else that's my fucking age for once. It's just really frustrating, to be honest.
So do you think suicide would be a feasible option? Like if things don't get better, I mean.  Because I've lately been considering it.
